name: uart_echo
title: UART Echo
description: UART1 echo example using GPIO17 TX and GPIO16 RX. Receives data on UART1 and echoes it back. Demonstrates UART initialization, non-blocking read, and TX/RX crossover wiring.
validation_note: NOT verified on hardware. Code review only — no UART adapter/loopback test was performed. Validate on your board before relying on it.
